Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, Please Welcome The Newest Record Holder: Jasper Jenkins, The Oldest Human To Ever Live!

Jasper steps up to the microphone, a wide smile spreading across his face. He adjusts his hearing aid and begins to speak.

JASPER
I Am Truly Honored To Receive This Record. I've Lived A Long Life, And I'm Grateful For Every Moment.

The crowd erupts in applause as Jasper holds up the plaque, beaming with pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, the plaque from earlier displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at it, a faraway look in his eyes. Suddenly, his expression changes, and he becomes agitated.

JASPER (V.O.)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Find Yourself Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Reincarnation.

Jasper's eyes widen as he becomes increasingly agitated.

JASPER (V.O.)
It Said That Every Time I Die, I'll Reincarnate Into A New Body, And I'll Keep Living Forever. But What If I'm Not Really Living? What If I'm Just Trapped In This Never-Ending Cycle?

Jasper's voice rises to a fever pitch.

JASPER (V.O.)
What If I'm Not Even Me? What If I'm Just A Simulation, A Program Created By Some Advanced Civilization?

The room begins to spin, and Jasper's grip on reality starts to slip.

JASPER (V.O.)
I'M NOT ALIVE! I'M JUST A PROGRAM! I'M JUST A... (he screams, his voice echoing through the room)

Suddenly, Jasper's body begins to convulse, and he collapses onto the bed, overcome with a mental breakdown.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
